_help: Sample products. Edit freely. price = selling price, mrp = original price (discount and 'You save' are calculated), sale = show Sale tag. section: men | boys | girls. type: pant | shirt | tshirt | short | dress. To add a photo, put the file in public/img/products/ and set preview to "img/products/yourfile.jpg" (photos = extra images). Keep ids unique. Prices here are what the server charges. sizes = list of sizes shown to the customer (leave out or use [] for products with no size). Orders store the chosen size.
